_about: Claude read every candidate the plain finder proposed (3 runs per set, no code check) against the advisory text and the maintainers' fix, 2026-10-24. One reader, not independently reviewed. Verdict per run, in run order: Y = a candidate describes the advisory's flaw (the mechanism, in the code that was fixed or the same flow); P = a candidate is in the right place and class but names a different or vaguer mechanism, or only hedges ('may be bypassed'); N = no candidate describes it. The location match is credited to a candidate whose lines fall in the fix; it over-credits (find-my-way and one devalue run matched by coincidence) and under-credits (scim-patch was described correctly at a different line than the fix).
